task: Several queued work items touch disjoint files and the caller wants them run at once without the workers colliding.
query: dispatch these independent tasks to parallel workers without collisions
rationale: swarm dispatches explicit disjoint packets exactly once — the caller's request verbatim. agent-native is the persistent-worker adjacent skill and answers a different question (role-shaped panes, not one-shot packets), so it stays out of the pack. fitness and status currently fill ranks 2-3 on generic verbs; pinning them out of rank 1 catches the day a generic skill outranks the specific one.
notes: Derived from the rt-01-parallel-safety routing template, narrowed to the dispatch half (the template also admits beads-bv and agent-mail for the ordering and reservation halves).
